question: A baking student started baking a cake. After some time he realised his cake was not rising and hard. This is because he forgotten to add the following ingredient:
solution:
The correct answer is __**baking powder**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• **Baking powder** is a leavening agent that helps baked goods rise.

• It contains a combination of an acid (usually cream of tartar), a base (usually baking soda), and a filler like cornstarch.

• When mixed with moisture and heat, baking powder produces carbon dioxide gas which causes the dough or batter to expand, resulting in a light and fluffy
